Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a sales and use tax exemption for farm machinery and equipment sold at an auction.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a sales and use tax exemption for farm machineryand equipment sold at an auction; adding a new section to chapter 82.08RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to the sale of farm machinery andequipment by or through an auctioneer if the auctioneer took possessionof the machinery and equipment from an eligible farmer and the farmerprovided the auctioneer with an exemption certificate under RCW82.08.855. An auctioneer must keep records necessary for thedepartment to verify eligibility under this section. (2) The definitions in this subsection apply to this section. (a) "Agricultural products" and "eligible farmer" have the samemeaning as provided in RCW 82.08.855. (b) "Farm machinery and equipment" means machinery and equipmentused primarily for growing, raising, or producing agriculturalproducts.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply to the use of farmmachinery and equipment acquired by or through an auctioneer if theauctioneer took possession of the machinery and equipment from aneligible farmer and the farmer provided the auctioneer with anexemption certificate under RCW 82.08.855. (2) The definitions in section 1 of this act apply to this section.
